mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_info( appName, packageName, version, buildNumber, features, isBeta, path, createTime, downloadTimes, size ) VALUES( #{appName}, #{packageName}, #{version}, #{buildNumber}, #{features}, #{isBeta}, #{path}, NOW(), 0, #{size} )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM app_info WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = false
SELECT * FROM app_info WHERE packageName = #{packageName} AND deleted = false
SELECT * FROM app_info WHERE packageName = #{packageName} AND version = #{version} AND deleted = false
SELECT * FROM app_info WHERE deleted = false ORDER BY createTime DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE app_info SET deleted = true WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM app_info WHERE packageName = #{packageName} AND deleted = false AND isBeta = false AND (showUpdatePopup = 1 OR forceUpdate = 1) ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(version, '.', 1) AS UNSIGNED) DESC, CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(version, '.', 2), '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED) DESC, CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(version, '.', -2), '.', 1) AS UNSIGNED) DESC, CAST(buildNumber AS UNSIGNED) DESC, createTime DESC
